'''Nimi Chireen''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Resistance pilot]] from the [[planet]] [[Jaymir]].

==Biography==
[[File:NimiChereen-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Chireen destroys a turbolaser battery of an enemy ship.]]
Nimi Chireen was recruited into the Resistance by [[Ello Asty]] alongside her brother [[Aarton Chireen|Aarton]]. Chireen was held in reserve until after the [[Battle of Crait]], when she rejoined the remaining [[Resistance]] fighters.<ref name="TROS VD" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> Chireen was at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] and had just been assigned her own [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="X-Wing">{{FFGXW2|set=Heralds of Hope Squadron Pack|cardname=Nimi Chireen}}</ref> Commander [[Poe Dameron]] believed she had great potential.<ref name="TROS novel">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]''</ref> After the [[Battle of Exegol]] and the destruction of [[Darth Sidious]] and the [[Sith Eternal]], she joined in the victory celebrations.<ref name="Episode IX" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nimi Chireen first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]]. She was played by British actress [[Mimi Ndiweni]], who was credited as "Resistance Officer".<ref name="Episode IX" /> The character's first name is similar to the actress' name.
